lines.name: l1
lines.text: You could buy this jet tomorrow and still be broke in a year. Here's why.

lines.name: l2
lines.text: It costs around seventy million dollars. But just to keep it flying, owners spend about eleven thousand dollars for every hour in the air.

lines.name: l3
lines.text: Fly it four hundred and fifty hours a year, and that's around five million dollars.

lines.name: l4
lines.text: Pilots, fuel, the hangar, insurance. Every single year.

lines.name: l5
lines.text: The jet is the cheap part. Keeping it is the real price.
